definitions.explanation: An indefinite span of several decades. Formed from {何|なん} (how many) plus {十年|じゅうねん}, it states that the number of decades is large or unknown rather than asking for it.

examples.japanese: {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{守|まも}られて→守る：01986_mamoru⟧きた。
examples.english: This temple has been looked after for decades.

examples.japanese: {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Young people are saying that even decades of work won't buy them a house.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always followed by ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, which supplies the sense of "as many as." Without ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ the phrase reads as a genuine question — {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (how many decades will it take?).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: decades ago
- {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: for the first time in decades
- {何十年|なんじゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: over the course of decades

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数十年|すうじゅうねん}→数十年：30639_suujuunen⟧: several decades — the written, more measured equivalent
- ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: for many years — a smaller, vaguer span
